latestVersion.changelog:
agent-credit 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Enables agents to autonomously borrow and repay on Aave V2/V3 using credit delegation.
- Supports borrow, repay, and health checks with built-in safety (e.g., health factor enforcement, delegation allowance, per-tx limits).
- Compatible with OpenClaw, Claude Code, Bankr, and shell-based workflows.
- Works across major EVM chains (Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Polygon).
- Includes detailed setup instructions and status scripts for easy onboarding.
